name: Audio Formant Analysis
description: Analyzes speech formant frequencies (F1-F4) — voice synthesis often produces unnatural formant transitions.
mechanism:
This method analyzes speech formant structure for audio deepfake detection following Chetty & Wagner (2006):

1. **포먼트추출**: Speech segments are analyzed using Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) to extract formant frequencies F1-F4 and their bandwidths. Formants are the resonant frequencies of the vocal tract, determined by physical anatomy — tongue position, jaw opening, and vocal tract length.

2. **포먼트Trajectory분석**: Temporal trajectories of formant frequencies are tracked across phoneme transitions. Natural speech shows smooth, physiologically constrained formant transitions governed by articulatory dynamics. AI-generated speech may exhibit unnaturally abrupt formant shifts or overly smooth trajectories lacking natural micro-variations.

3. **Speaker-Specific포먼트모델링**: Each speaker has characteristic formant ranges determined by vocal tract geometry. The method builds a speaker-specific formant model and checks consistency — deepfake audio may inadvertently blend formant characteristics from source and target speakers, creating acoustically impossible vocal tract configurations.

4. **포먼트Bandwidth분석**: Natural formant bandwidths reflect the damping properties of the vocal tract. AI synthesis often produces formants with unnatural bandwidth patterns — either too narrow (over-resonant) or too uniform across frequency bands, lacking the frequency-dependent damping of real vocal tracts.

5. **Harmonic-to-포먼트Ratio**: The relationship between harmonic series and formant peaks is analyzed. In natural speech, harmonics interact with formant resonances in predictable ways governed by source-filter theory. Synthetic speech may show anomalous harmonic-formant relationships indicating generated rather than physical sound production.

strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
